instruction: Laura has asked for my movie recommendations via phone text message. Reply to them with a list of comma-separated movie titles from my Simple Note account as per their request.
notes: Fixed the name clash: the predicate is now (known-director ?p ?d) and the director object is laura-requested-director, so no predicate/object share a name. Two-app task (phone + simple_note) with no answer; supervisor.complete_task takes only task-record parameters (person, message) so its precondition mirrors the goal (message-sent laura reply-movie-titles) and it is the only action that can add (task-completed), while all other actions require (not (task-completed)). Usernames come from supervisor.show_profile (profile-known required before login), passwords from show_account_passwords. phone.search_contacts discovers Laura's phone number; phone.search_text_messages (query + phone_number) discovers the director she asked about; simple_note.search_notes discovers the note id and simple_note.show_note reveals its content. The reply message is statically linked (reply-for) to the director and the note so phone.send_text_message can only fire after both pieces of knowledge are gathered. The optional dont_reorder_pinned=true used in the reference search_notes call is not modelled as a parameter.
